title: CommandTest
description: How the hook treats a command line under proposed rules.

commands.description: Every simple command of the line, in order.

lease.description:
The one lease the hook asks for: the class of every heavy command combined. `None`
when no command is heavy.

ClassSize.description: A class with the size the proposed settings give it.

min_cores.description: The fewest cores a lease of it starts with: its own minimum, or the automatic one.

profile.description: What a lease of it asks for.

CommandKind.description: How the rules treat one simple command.

oneOf.description: A rule matches, so it needs a lease.
A rule matches, but a light flag makes it only print and exit.

CommandResult.description: One simple command of a tested line.

command.description: Its words joined by spaces, wrappers such as `sudo` included.

flag.description: The first light flag among its arguments, for a print-only command.

kind.description: How the proposed rules treat it.

rule_index.description: Position of the first matching rule, from 0, for a heavy command.

size.description: The lease a heavy command needs on its own; `None` for the others.

JobClass.description: Named job profiles. Their values come from the `[classes]` section of the config.

oneOf.description: Short jobs that barely load the machine.
Compiles, test suites, and other CPU-bound work.
Training, rendering, games, and other GPU-bound work.
Jobs that load both the CPU and the GPU.

JobProfile.description: Resources a job is expected to need while it runs.

cores.description: Logical cores the job keeps busy.

gpu_pct.description: GPU engine load as a percentage of one adapter.
